title: One record of the processes each agent started; end only those at SubagentStop; kill-only-yours reads it
ruling: Owner 14:37 CST Nov 13, relayed by the retrospective, on its 14:36 reframe: "i agree ensure that triage marks that". Before that, 14:36: "if the excel lesson is specific to excel it can run for just areas that use excel? ... tho i imagine the takeaway from the excel session if reviewed from outcomes based is more broad than just what we're describing right?". Meaning: step office-pids-per-agent becomes agent-owned-processes. One record of what each agent started; end only those at SubagentStop (start time checked; a visible window or an unclear owner is reported, never ended); the kill-only-yours guard reads that record; Office is one Windows adapter with an early exit elsewhere; sim-lease joins the same record, not a second home. The step text and design are the retrospective's, unread by triage.
